candidate.text: We map p^2 + 3q^2 = t^3 to the PID Z[omega]. Coprimality of (p + q sqrt(-3)) and (p - q sqrt(-3)) follows from gcd(p,q)=1 and 3 does not divide p. Cube extraction yields alpha^3 up to a unit. Unit group has order 6, and odd coordinate difference excludes all non-trivial roots of unity.
